description: Sidecar feature flags. Set "enabled" to true or false per feature. Both proxy-tee and mcp-gateway hot-reload this file; see sidecar/docs/FEATURE_FLAGS.md.

ingest_flights.description: Copy /api/flights responses (civil aircraft) into Tile38 and TimescaleDB.

ingest_military.description: Copy /api/military responses (military aircraft) into Tile38 and TimescaleDB.

ingest_vessels.description: Copy /api/vessels responses (AIS ships) into Tile38 and TimescaleDB.

ingest_wildfires.description: Copy /api/firms responses (NASA FIRMS fire hotspots) into Tile38 and TimescaleDB.

ingest_satellite_tles.description: Archive /api/celestrak/* TLE sets into tle_archive (needed by satellite passes and scene context).

history_archive.description: Write telemetry and TLEs to TimescaleDB. When off, only the live Tile38 tier is updated.

headless_keepalive.description: Poll upstream feeds in the background when no browser has been active for 60 seconds.

playback_replay.description: Historical replay switch (/__sidecar/playback, /api/replay) that serves flights and vessels from TimescaleDB.

ui_bridge_injection.description: Inject copilot-bridge.js into the upstream HTML page so the globe connects to the gateway.

mobile_gps_page.description: Serve the mobile browser GPS transmitter page at /gps and /mobile-gps.

android_apk_download.description: Serve the Sentinel GPS Android APK at /apk, /download/apk and /sentinel-gps.apk.

https_listener.description: Start the HTTPS listener on PROXY_HTTPS_PORT (8443) for mobile GPS secure contexts.

mcp_sse_transport.description: Expose the MCP server over SSE at /mcp/sse. REST /api/tools/* stays available.

upstream_tool_federation.description: Discover and re-expose the upstream God's Eye View MCP tools through the gateway.

anchor_resolution.description: resolve_anchor: place names, airport codes, callsigns and MMSIs to coordinates.

scene_context.description: get_scene_context: live or historical contact roster, environment digest and overhead satellites.

static_infrastructure.description: find_static_infrastructure: PostGIS lookup of datacenters, dams, cables and bases.

visual_cockpit.description: control_visual_cockpit: camera fly-to, entity selection, layer toggles and replay in the open globe.

tripwire_sentinel.description: 20-second tripwire loop: emergency squawks, AOI incursions, cable anchor drag, dark contacts.

aoi_management.description: Area-of-interest API and tools, plus 3D AOI perimeter rings in the globe.

notify_browser_hud.description: Show alert banners on the Cesium globe.

notify_desktop.description: Show alerts as native browser desktop notifications.

notify_telegram.description: Send alerts to Telegram (credentials in watchlists.json or TELEGRAM_* env vars).

notify_discord.description: Send alerts to a Discord webhook (URL in watchlists.json or DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL).

notify_slack.description: Send alerts to a Slack webhook (URL in watchlists.json or SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL).

notify_alert_log.description: Persist every alert to the tactical_alerts table.

intsum_reports.description: Generate and dispatch INTSUM intelligence summaries on demand.

intsum_schedule.description: Automatically dispatch an INTSUM for Bangalore every 12 hours.

kinematics_cpa.description: Closest point of approach (CPA/TCPA) between contacts and airspace conflict scans.

pattern_of_life.description: Dark-contact (transponder silence) and manoeuvre anomaly detection.

radar_horizons.description: Radar line-of-sight coverage tools and 3D radar domes in the globe.

sdr_ingest.description: RTL-SDR ADS-B/AIS ingestion engine, API and tools.

cot_atak.description: Cursor-on-Target UDP broadcaster to ATAK/WinTAK/iTAK, including alert forwarding.

meshtastic_relay.description: Meshtastic LoRa mesh relay, API and tools, including alert forwarding.

escort_bubbles.description: Escort / guardian bubbles: engine, API, tools, globe bubbles and HUD.

traffic_vehicle_tagging.description: tag_traffic_vehicle: follow a live TomTom traffic vehicle with an escort bubble.

feature_admin_mcp.description: Let AI assistants toggle features through the set_sidecar_feature MCP tool.
